column1: # kenning-zephyr-runtime workspace for `./kenning-box kzr setup` (tab separated). Checked 2026-10-29.
# Each source is fetched shallow at the pinned commit into install/kzr/<name> and the checkout is verified
# against the commit hash. Zephyr itself is NOT here: it comes from 32_03_zephyr (BOX_ZEPHYR), used read-only.
# kzr upstream west.yml pins zephyr v4.3.0 + tflite-micro zephyr-v4.1.0; 32_03 has Zephyr v4.4.2, whose
# tflite-micro glue (zephyr/modules/tflite-micro) needs the matching zephyr-v4.4.0 branch.
# executorch, zephelin, emlearn and ai8x are not fetched (no example uses them).
